title: ao.erp-module-map/v1 — the ERP module map (frozen, issue #646)
description: The catalogue's module map: which pillars the module binds to, and which of the epic's children build which part. It is a POINTER list by design — a child is named by its issue number and its short id, never by a restatement of its scope, because the scope prose lives in docs/ERP-MODULE-GAP-ANALYSIS.md and a second copy of it here would be the second knowledge store this module exists to refuse. Every object is closed (`additionalProperties: false`).

pillars.description: The product pillars the module binds to. `path` is a real directory in this repository, so a map cannot name a pillar that does not exist.

children.description: The epic's children, by issue number and short id. Every document's `owning_issue` must be one of these.
